description: Research several current official-source software routes for hallway, burned-site, house-terrain, solar and sprinkler component demos. Include phone capture, AutoCAD/SketchUp where appropriate, specialist survey and solar drone/robot inspection tools, and supported automation interfaces. Distinguish capabilities, hardware and untested integrations. Deliver a plain-language comparison in the private demo site with source links.

comments.text: Official-source research completed for 14 software products, mapped to five demos. Includes AutoCAD/SketchUp baselines, phone/photo capture, Revit/Civil 3D, professional laser scanning, mechanical part modeling, DroneDeploy ground-robot/aerial workflows and Raptor solar inspection records. Supported automation interfaces are documented without claiming integrations installed. Thermal inspection and dimensional survey remain distinct.

title: Research practical software alternatives for each 3D demo
